setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; installation does not provision any event delivery.
Publish the existing ONF HTTP listener through a reviewed HTTPS proxy preserving raw JSON bytes and required authentication headers.
Save the callback secret in Infrastructure → Secrets; create an ingress profile for this package requirement using HMAC SHA256; X-Hub-Signature, literal prefix sha256=.
Bind the intended trigger node to that profile, save its provider filters, and deliberately enable both workflow and entry.
Use Jira Cloud administrator-created webhooks with a saved secret token and SHA256 signatures; set X-Hub-Signature and prefix sha256=.
Include body, select the event and optional JQL filters. Connect JWT callbacks require a separately verified relay and are not this direct contract.
Authorize a synthetic provider delivery and inspect its accepted run; HTTP 202 proves admission only. Review provider retries and downstream idempotency.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it.
